name: Continuous-Claude-v3
title_zh: 上下文账本式管理，Claude Code 长跑不掉链
tagline_zh: 会话一长，Claude 就忘前忘后？这套钩子用账本和交接单维持状态，MCP 执行不污染上下文。
tagline_en: Long sessions making Claude forgetful? Hooks keep state via ledgers & handoffs, run MCP without polluting.
desc_en: Context management for Claude Code. Hooks maintain state via ledgers and handoffs. MCP execution without context pollution. Agent orchestration with isolated context windows.
why_zh: 不是塞进更多上下文，而是把状态外置成账本。每个钩子只读写该读的格子。
why_en: Instead of cramming more context, it externalizes state into ledgers. Each hook reads/writes only its slot; handoffs assign.
limit_zh: 只适配 Claude Code 的钩子体系，不适用于其他 CLI。需要你按项目配置钩子触发点。
limit_en: Only works with Claude Code's hook system, not other CLIs. Requires per-project hook setup; ledger files need manual versioning or state is lost on.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Ledger-based context manager for Claude Code marathons
